summary: Bind no-site platform product shares to the same first-listed Store selected by the anonymous business-slug route. Refuse a share from a different authorized Store rather than returning an indistinguishable URL with another Store's product availability, price or public contact.
noAssistantImpact: This narrows existing public/share read eligibility only. It adds no assistant command, business write, permission, capability, channel or provider effect. Owner/Admin listing forms remain form_only; product share continues through existing catalog productShare reads and current tenant/Store authorization. Public URLs, listing consent, projections, Site host verification and rollouts are unchanged.

docs.note: Phase4 source repair, assistant exclusion and acceptance dependencies.
Reproduction, focused checks, unchanged-source proof reuse and remaining connected/consent/media gates.

evidence.result: Inert real-query reproduction failed for a scoped second Store while anonymous resolution used the first listed Store. After binding canonical selection, the final combined query/host/marketing suites pass 21 tests / 75 assertions, including ordinary canonical scope, mismatch refusal before Site/catalog reads and the actual getPlatformProductShare chain. Whole DB types (8GB heap), scoped quick285/1820, Biome and H01 pass. Regression execution has no DB/provider call.
